## Warehouse Operations: ModaViva, S.L.

For approval by Ana Whitfield. Prices in EUR. Rate card 2026-11-indicative-1: indicative prices, to be confirmed by Commercial.

TrackFlow offers warehousing at its Zaragoza site, with capacity of up to 5,000 pallet positions. Storage is charged by occupied volume; the rate card also lists per-pallet receiving and one-time SKU setup fees.

### Scope and approach

The Zaragoza site meets the request for a center near Zaragoza and supports operations in Spain. ModaViva sells online in Spain and Portugal, but the information provided does not confirm delivery coverage for Portugal. The site’s stated capacity is indicative and does not alone confirm space for approximately 15,000 SKUs. We need the units per SKU and expected pallet mix to assess fit.

Storage is priced by occupied cubic meter, not by pallet or SKU. The per-pallet charge is for inbound receiving, and the per-SKU charge is for one-time SKU setup. Storage is not discounted. The rate card’s inbound receiving and SKU setup prices are indicative. Reverse logistics is requested, but its processing scope and rates are not specified here.

Onboarding is 10 business days from contract signature to the first order shipped; this timing is indicative and depends on receiving the required setup information. The proposal is due August 28, 2026, but no operational start date was provided, so fit against a start date cannot be assessed. TrackFlow commits to a 90% monthly on-time delivery SLA, measured by country.

### Pricing

| Item | Price | Unit | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Storage, per cubic meter occupied | 16.00 EUR | per m³ per month | Per m³ occupied per month; not discountable |
| Inbound receiving | 8.50 EUR | per pallet | Per pallet received; indicative |
| SKU setup (one-off) | 0.25 EUR | per SKU | One-time per SKU; indicative |

### Volume discount tiers

Discounts by orders a month apply to every price above except storage, per cubic meter occupied and sku setup (one-off).

| Monthly volume (orders) | Discount |
|---|---|
| 0 to 2,499 orders a month | 0% |
| 2,500 to 9,999 orders a month | 5% |
| 10,000 to 24,999 orders a month | 8% |
| 25,000 or more orders a month | 12% |

### Service commitments

- Storage site: Zaragoza.
- Committed capacity: 5,000 pallet positions and up to 45,000 orders a month.
- Onboarding: 10 business days.
- The first 30 days of any new product in inventory incur no storage charge.
- Inventory with more than 180 days of no movement pays a long-term inventory fee of 150% over the standard storage rate, starting on day 181.
- Clients averaging more than 50 cubic meters a month can ask for a preferential storage rate, negotiated only by Miguel Torres.
- On-time delivery SLA: TrackFlow commits to 90% on-time deliveries per month, measured by country for the deliveries TrackFlow manages.
- If a country falls below 90% for two consecutive months, the client is entitled to a 5% compensation on that country's monthly fee.
- The SLA is not guaranteed on declared high-demand dates (Black Friday, Christmas, January Sales in Spain), when delivery times may extend by up to 40%.

### Assumptions

- Zaragoza site capacity and onboarding timing are indicative per the rate card.
- Storage charges are based on occupied cubic meters; no storage discount is included.
- Discount tiers apply to discountable prices only and are based on monthly orders.

### Pending information

- What monthly order volume should we use?
- How many units are expected per SKU, and what is the required pallet quantity and pallet mix, to confirm capacity for approximately 15,000 SKUs?
- What inventory and space profile should be used to validate capacity and storage pricing?
- What returns processing, inspection, disposition, and timing requirements should warehouse operations support?
- What operational start date is required, and when can the contract be signed?
- Can the team confirm delivery coverage and service requirements for Portugal?
- What is the expected monthly order volume? It is not stated in the RFP.
- What are the required pallet quantities, SKU-level storage profile, and inventory/space assumptions needed to confirm capacity and price?
- What are the client's detailed reverse-logistics (returns) requirements that affect warehouse operations, capacity, or onboarding?

## Reverse Logistics: ModaViva, S.L.

For approval by Sofía Ramos. Prices in EUR. Rate card 2026-11-indicative-1: indicative prices, to be confirmed by Commercial.

TrackFlow handles return receipt, inspection, classification, and restocking under ModaViva’s rules. Reconditioning is available when those rules request it, at indicative EUR rates.

### Scope and approach

TrackFlow receives, inspects, classifies, and restocks returns under ModaViva’s rules. Reconditioning is available when those rules request it. TrackFlow follows ModaViva’s decisions and does not choose whether an item is repaired or resold. The listed rates are indicative and in EUR. Discounts apply only to eligible rates and depend on monthly return volume.

The indicative turnaround is 72 hours from warehouse arrival to classification. It does not confirm the time needed for reconditioning or completed restocking. Please confirm the turnaround target for those steps. The proposal deadline is August 28, 2026. No service start date was provided, so no start-date fit can be assessed.

The standard return window is 30 days from delivery, unless ModaViva sets another contract window. ModaViva pays return shipping, except when a TrackFlow error caused the return; TrackFlow then pays. International returns are returns bought in one country and sent back from another. These are not part of the standard automated process. Sofía Ramos’s team handles them manually. Please share monthly return volume or return rate, product and SKU mix, and item condition groups. Also share requested reconditioning tasks and any service-level needs. These details are needed to assess the work and confirm timing.

### Pricing

| Item | Price | Unit | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Returns processing (receive, inspect, classify and restock) | 2.80 EUR | per return | Indicative; per return. |
| Reconditioning, when the client's rules ask for it | 1.60 EUR | per unit | Indicative; per unit when ModaViva’s rules request it. |

### Volume discount tiers

Discounts by returns a month apply to every price above.

| Monthly volume (returns) | Discount |
|---|---|
| 0 to 499 returns a month | 0% |
| 500 to 1,999 returns a month | 5% |
| 2,000 to 4,999 returns a month | 8% |
| 5,000 or more returns a month | 12% |

### Service commitments

- Returns turnaround: 72 hours from arrival at the warehouse to classification.
- Return window: 30 days from delivery.
- Return shipping: ModaViva pays return shipping, except when a TrackFlow error caused the return; TrackFlow pays in that case.
- International returns: International returns (purchased in one country and returned in another) are outside the standard automated process and require manual handling by Sofía Ramos’s team.

### Assumptions

- Rates are indicative and in EUR. Volume discounts apply only to discountable rates and depend on monthly returns.
- TrackFlow reconditions items only when ModaViva’s rules request it.

### Pending information

- What monthly returns volume or return rate should be used? What is the monthly order volume?
- What product and SKU mix, and what item condition categories, should guide inspection and reconditioning?
- What reconditioning tasks and additional service-level requirements are expected?
- What turnaround target should apply to reconditioning and completed restocking? The rate card gives timing only through classification.
- What is the expected returns volume (e.g., monthly returns or return rate)?
- What product/SKU mix and condition categories should be used for estimating inspection and reconditioning effort?
- What reconditioning tasks or service-level requirements are expected beyond the stated scope?

## Warehouse Operations: Luna Cosmetics

For approval by Ana Whitfield. Prices in USD. Rate card 2026-11-indicative-1: indicative prices, to be confirmed by Commercial.

TrackFlow offers Luna Cosmetics warehousing at its Los Angeles site, with listed capacity of 6,000 pallet positions and up to 60,000 orders monthly; these capacities are indicative. Storage is priced by occupied cubic meter, while inbound receiving is priced per pallet and SKU setup per SKU.

### Scope and approach

Luna reports 5,000 orders monthly and needs warehousing and shipping across the US. The Los Angeles site lists 6,000 pallet positions and capacity for up to 60,000 orders monthly; both figures are indicative. We cannot recommend Luna’s required storage allocation from order volume alone. Inventory levels and pallet mix are needed to confirm fit.

Storage is charged by cubic meter occupied, not by pallet or SKU. Inbound receiving is charged per pallet, and SKU setup is a one-time fee per SKU. The rate card lists these fees below; storage is not discountable. If average monthly storage exceeds 50 cubic meters, Miguel Torres handles any preferential-rate negotiation.

The indicative onboarding time is 10 business days from signed contract to first order shipped. This appears to fit the requested three-week window if the contract is signed promptly and setup and inbound details are ready. The RFP says around August 24, but gives no complete target date. Please confirm the date. Nationwide delivery details belong in the Last Mile section.

### Pricing

| Item | Price | Unit | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Storage, per cubic meter occupied | 18.00 USD | per m³ per month | Per cubic meter occupied per month; not discountable. |
| Inbound receiving | 9.50 USD | per pallet | Per pallet; indicative. |
| SKU setup (one-off) | 0.30 USD | per SKU | One-off per SKU; indicative. |
| Pick and pack | 2.40 USD | per order | Per order; indicative. |
| Each additional item in the same order | 0.45 USD | per item | Each additional item in the same order; indicative. |

### Volume discount tiers

Discounts by orders a month apply to every price above except storage, per cubic meter occupied and sku setup (one-off).

| Monthly volume (orders) | Discount |
|---|---|
| 0 to 2,499 orders a month | 0% |
| 2,500 to 9,999 orders a month | 5% |
| 10,000 to 24,999 orders a month | 8% |
| 25,000 or more orders a month | 12% |

### Service commitments

- Storage site: Los Angeles.
- Committed capacity: 6,000 pallet positions and up to 60,000 orders a month.
- Onboarding: 10 business days.
- The first 30 days of any new product in inventory incur no storage charge.
- Inventory with more than 180 days of no movement pays a long-term inventory fee of 150% over the standard storage rate, starting on day 181.
- Clients averaging more than 50 cubic meters a month can ask for a preferential storage rate, negotiated only by Miguel Torres.

### Assumptions

- Rate-card capacity figures are indicative, not a confirmed allocation.

### Pending information

- What inventory quantities and target stock levels should guide storage planning?
- How many pallets and SKUs are expected, and what are the SKU dimensions, weights, and storage needs? Please also provide units per SKU and the expected pallet mix so we can confirm site fit.
- What cosmetics-specific temperature, safety, or regulatory handling requirements apply?
- What inbound inventory volume and timing, order profile, and operational requirements will affect setup and onboarding?
- What is the complete target go-live date? The RFP only gives an approximate date around August 24. Please also confirm when the contract can be signed.

- What are the product characteristics and handling needs (including any cosmetics-specific temperature, safety, or regulatory requirements)?
- What is the complete target go-live date? The stated timeframe is around August 24th, but no full date is provided.
- What inbound inventory volume and timing, order profile, and operational requirements will affect warehouse setup and onboarding?

## Last Mile and Carrier Management: Luna Cosmetics

For approval by Carlos Vega. Prices in USD. Rate card 2026-11-indicative-1: indicative prices, to be confirmed by Commercial.

TrackFlow offers Luna Cosmetics US-wide last-mile delivery and carrier management from Los Angeles. We support carrier selection based on shipment details and commit to a 90% monthly on-time delivery SLA, measured across the United States.

### Scope and approach

Indicative shipment prices are in USD and depend on service and parcel weight. Standard pricing covers parcels up to 2 kg or from 2 to 5 kg; express is available only in the Los Angeles metropolitan area. The stated 5,000 monthly orders are not confirmed shipments, so applicable shipment discounts depend on actual monthly shipment volume.

UPS, FedEx, and DHL are listed for US operations. UPS has full national coverage; FedEx is noted for express delivery within California. DHL is identified as the reliable option for international shipments from Los Angeles, so its domestic destination availability needs confirmation. TrackFlow’s system selects carriers using destination, weight, product type, and urgency. Exceptions require Carlos Vega’s approval.

Standard delivery is 3 to 5 business days within the United States. Express delivery is 24 to 48 hours within its Los Angeles metropolitan coverage; FedEx is noted for express timing within California. These are service-level transit times, not separate carrier-specific guarantees. The 90% on-time SLA is measured monthly by country, not by carrier or service. During declared high-demand dates, delivery times may extend by up to 40%, and the SLA is not guaranteed. The rate card gives no onboarding duration, so fit with the requested timing cannot be confirmed; it depends on the full start date and onboarding timeline.

### Pricing

| Item | Price | Unit | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard delivery, parcel up to 2 kg (3 to 5 business days) | 6.90 USD | per shipment | Per shipment, parcel up to 2 kg; indicative. |
| Standard delivery, parcel from 2 to 5 kg (3 to 5 business days) | 8.90 USD | per shipment | Per shipment, parcel from 2 to 5 kg; indicative. |
| Express delivery (24 to 48 hours, express coverage area only) | 12.50 USD | per shipment | Per shipment; Los Angeles metropolitan area only; indicative. |

### Volume discount tiers

Discounts by shipments a month apply to every price above.

| Monthly volume (shipments) | Discount |
|---|---|
| 0 to 2,499 shipments a month | 0% |
| 2,500 to 9,999 shipments a month | 5% |
| 10,000 to 24,999 shipments a month | 8% |
| 25,000 or more shipments a month | 12% |

### Service commitments

- Standard delivery: 3 to 5 business days (Within the United States.).
- Express delivery: 24 to 48 hours (Los Angeles metropolitan area only.).
- Planned volume: 5,000 orders a month, as the client states.
- On-time delivery SLA: TrackFlow commits to 90% on-time deliveries per month, measured by country.
- If a country falls below 90% for two consecutive months, the client is entitled to a 5% compensation on that country's monthly fee.
- The SLA is not guaranteed on declared high-demand dates (Black Friday, Christmas, January Sales in Spain), when delivery times may extend by up to 40%.

### Carriers by destination

| Destination | Carriers |
|---|---|
| United States (national destinations) | UPS, FedEx, DHL |
| Los Angeles metropolitan area (express) | FedEx |

### Assumptions

- Rates are indicative and quoted in USD.
- Standard rates depend on parcel weight; dimensions and special handling may affect carrier availability and final pricing.
- Discount tiers apply to monthly shipments, not orders; the stated 5,000 monthly orders are not confirmed shipment volume.

### Pending information

- Which states, ZIP codes, or destination distribution should we assess for carrier availability and pricing?
- What are typical parcel weights, dimensions, service preferences, and special handling requirements?
- How many of the 5,000 monthly orders will ship, and what is the destination mix?
